context.body: The discourse narrows attention from future necessities to the present day.

observations.body: Jesus repeats the warning against anxious questions about necessities and contrasts the nations’ seeking with the Father’s knowledge.
observations.label: Kingdom seeking is placed before tomorrow: action

observations.body: The hearers are told to seek God’s Kingdom and righteousness first and to leave tomorrow’s trouble to tomorrow.
observations.label: Kingdom seeking is placed before tomorrow: response

payload.posture: Read Matthew 6:31–34 as treasure, service, and tomorrow evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The promise that “all these things” will be added requires reading alongside the preceding necessities and the wider canon’s suffering.
